change.summary: Render two small day/season indicators from native synchronized time and Serene Seasons state; change no gameplay calendars.

modifiers.before: No JEM day/season HUD indicator in JEMCompat; native Minecraft and Serene Seasons calendar remain owners.
modifiers.after: Optional 24x24 day and season indicators at GUI position8,8 with gap4, configurable position/toggles, F1 hide and hover text in chat/container screens. Seasonal pointer and progress use native ISeasonState/config. Nonseasonal dimensions show neutral presentation; absent Serene Seasons hides that indicator. No time mutation or independent calendar.

cause.owner: JEMCompat client.time and isolated compat.seasons adapter

rationale.purpose: The user requests implementation of section4 of the final v2 brief while preserving existing architecture and source authority.
rationale.decision_source: User specified indicator size, layout, native synchronization, optional-mod behavior and presentation-only scope. Codex chose Forge client event hooks, an isolated optional adapter and native calendar API reuse.

introduced.summary: Add presentation-only native day/season HUD source.

history.summary: Add native day/season HUD source without changing native calendar mechanics.

impacts.notes: Installed API/bytecode9.1.0.3 and local config inspected. Existing day and season rules remain unchanged. Presentation only; no original registry fact is overwritten.
